analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 중이며, ADX는 26.7로 추세가 뚜렷하나 +DI 12.5 대비 -DI 32.2로 하락 압력이 우위. 현재가 $0.19는 스윙 지지선에 근접하며 볼린저밴드 하단에 위치. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 2.05배로 급증했으나, 추세 강도 지표인 ADX가 20 미만 구간에서 급등락을 반복하며 추세 형성 초기 단계에 머물러 있어 방향성 확정은 이르다.
analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI is entering oversold territory, and ADX at 26.7 indicates a clear trend, but the downward pressure is dominant with -DI at 32.2 versus +DI at 12.5. The current price of $0.19 is near the swing support and located at the lower Bollinger Band. Volume surged 2.05x the 5-day average, but the trend strength indicator ADX remains in the early stages of trend formation, oscillating between rapid rises and falls below 20, making direction confirmation premature.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today, RSI declined from 34.6 to 32.9, and MACD histogram improved from -0.0034 to -0.0027, maintaining a bearish convergence phase. ADX rose from 22.5 to 26.7, but the -DI dominance persists, indicating weak trend reversal signals.
